verdict.rationale: Smithery was a hosted platform that stored credentials and connections, so data residency is a fair question for it. Nothing in the pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. 'Encrypted, write-only storage' says nothing about location. Uplink running a server on your own machine is an adjacent workaround, not a residency control. The shutdown notice also says the hosted services are discontinued, leaving no surface for such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
